columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique identifier for each examination record.
Date when the examination was performed.
Level of anticardiolipin IgG antibodies in the blood.
Level of anticardiolipin IgM antibodies in the blood.
Antinuclear antibody titer value.
Pattern of antinuclear antibody staining (e.g., P, S, D).
Level of anticardiolipin IgA antibodies in the blood.
Diagnosis or diagnoses associated with the patient (e.g., SLE, MCTD).
Kaolin clotting time test result (positive or negative).
Russell viper venom time test result (positive or negative).
Lupus anticoagulant test result (positive or negative).
Symptoms reported or observed (e.g., AMI, CNS lupus, thrombocytopenia).
Indicator or count of thrombosis events (0, 1, 2, 3).

prediction.purpose: Stores laboratory examination results and diagnoses for patients, including antiphospholipid antibody tests and thrombosis indicators.

columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique numeric identifier for each patient.
Biological sex of the patient, coded as 'F' for female, 'M' for male, or empty.
Date of birth of the patient.
Date associated with a description or record entry for the patient.
First recorded date for the patient, possibly first visit or admission.
Admission status indicator, with '+' for admitted, '-' for not admitted, or empty.
Diagnosis or suspected diagnosis for the patient, e.g., 'RA susp.', 'SLE', 'MCTD'.

prediction.purpose: Stores demographic and clinical information for patients in a thrombosis prediction context.

columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique identifier for the patient or lab record.
Date when the laboratory test was performed or recorded.
Level of aspartate aminotransferase, a liver enzyme.
Level of alanine aminotransferase, a liver enzyme.
Level of lactate dehydrogenase, an enzyme found in many body tissues.
Level of alkaline phosphatase, an enzyme related to liver and bone function.
Total protein level in the blood.
Albumin level in the blood.
Uric acid level in the blood.
Urea nitrogen level in the blood, a measure of kidney function.
Creatinine level in the blood, a measure of kidney function.
Total bilirubin level in the blood.
Total cholesterol level in the blood.
Triglyceride level in the blood.
Creatine phosphokinase level, an enzyme found in heart and skeletal muscle.
Glucose level in the blood.
White blood cell count.
Red blood cell count.
Hemoglobin level in the blood.
Hematocrit level, the proportion of blood volume occupied by red blood cells.
Platelet count.
Prothrombin time, a measure of blood clotting.
Activated partial thromboplastin time, a measure of blood clotting.
Fibrinogen level, a blood clotting factor.
Plasminogen activator inhibitor complex level, related to fibrinolysis.
Thrombin-antithrombin complex level, a marker of coagulation activation.
Another measure of thrombin-antithrombin complex, possibly a different assay.
Protein level in urine, often measured semi-quantitatively.
Immunoglobulin G level in the blood.
Immunoglobulin A level in the blood.
Immunoglobulin M level in the blood.
C-reactive protein level, a marker of inflammation.
Rheumatoid arthritis factor test result, often qualitative or semi-quantitative.
Rheumatoid factor level, often reported with a reference range.
Complement C3 level, part of the immune system.
Complement C4 level, part of the immune system.
Antibody to ribonucleoprotein, often associated with mixed connective tissue disease.
Antibody to Smith antigen, associated with systemic lupus erythematosus.
Antibody to Scl-70 (topoisomerase I), associated with systemic sclerosis.
Antibody to SSA (Ro), associated with Sjogren's syndrome and lupus.
Antibody to SSB (La), associated with Sjogren's syndrome and lupus.
Antibody to centromere, associated with limited systemic sclerosis (CREST syndrome).
Antibody to double-stranded DNA, highly specific for systemic lupus erythematosus.
Another assay for anti-double-stranded DNA antibody, possibly a different method.

prediction.purpose: Stores laboratory test results for patients, including blood chemistry, hematology, coagulation, immunology, and serology tests.

cases.title: What is the disease patient '30609' diagnosed with. List all the date of la
cases.question:
What is the disease patient '30609' diagnosed with. List all the date of laboratory tests done for this patient.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: '30609' is the Patient ID; disease means Diagnosis

cases.title: Among the patients whose creatinine level is abnormal, how many of them are
cases.question:
Among the patients whose creatinine level is abnormal, how many of them aren't 70 yet?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: creatinine level is abnormal refers to CRE >= 1.5; aren't 70 yet refers to SUBTRACT((YEAR(CURDATE()), YEAR(Birthday))) < 70;

cases.title: For the patient who was born on 1959/2/18, what is the decrease rate for hi
cases.question:
For the patient who was born on 1959/2/18, what is the decrease rate for his/her total cholesterol from November to December in 1981?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: born on 1959/2/18 refers to Birthday = '1959-02-18'; calculation = DIVISION(SUBTRACT(SUM(Birthday = '1959-02-18' and Date like '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO`), SUM(Birthday = '1959-02-18' and Date like '1981-12-%' THEN `T-CHO`)), SUM(Birthday = '1959-02-18' and Date like '1981-12-%' THEN `T-CHO`))

cases.title: List all patients who were followed up at the outpatient clinic who underwe
cases.question:
List all patients who were followed up at the outpatient clinic who underwent a laboratory test in October 1991 and had a total blood bilirubin level within the normal range.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: followed up at the outpatient clinic refers to Admission = '-'; laboratory test in April 1981 refers to Date like '1991-10%'; blood bilirubin level within the normal range refers to T-BIL < 2.0;

cases.title: The oldest SJS patient's medical laboratory work was completed on what date
cases.question:
The oldest SJS patient's medical laboratory work was completed on what date, and what age was the patient when they initially arrived at the hospital?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa; 'SJS' refers to diagnosis; (SUBTRACT(year(`First Date`)), year(Birthday)); age of the patients when they initially arrived at the hospital refers to year(Birthday)

cases.title: Among the patients who has a normal level of anti-centromere and a normal l
cases.question:
Among the patients who has a normal level of anti-centromere and a normal level of anti-SSB, how many of them are male?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: normal level of anti-centromere refers to CENTROMEA IN('-', '+-'); normal level of anti-SSB refers to SSB IN('-', '+-'); male refers to Sex = 'M'; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;

cases.title: What are the patient's diagnosis for those who has lower red blood blood ce
cases.question:
What are the patient's diagnosis for those who has lower red blood blood cell? State their ID and age.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: patient's diagnosis refers to Diagnosis; lower red blood cell refers to RBC < 3.5; age = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday));

cases.title: Are there more in-patient or outpatient who were male? What is the deviatio
cases.question:
Are there more in-patient or outpatient who were male? What is the deviation in percentage?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: male refers to SEX = 'M'; in-patient refers to Admission = '+'; outpatient refers to Admission = '-'; percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(ID) where SEX = 'M' and Admission = '+', COUNT(ID) where SEX  = 'M' and Admission = '-')

cases.title: How many underage patients were examined during the course of the three-yea
cases.question:
How many underage patients were examined during the course of the three-year period from 1990 to 1993?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: underage patients refers to year(Birthday) < 18; three-year period from 1990 to 1993 refers to year(`Examination Date`) between '1990' and '1993'

cases.title: Name the ID and age of patient with two or more laboratory examinations whi
cases.question:
Name the ID and age of patient with two or more laboratory examinations which show their hematoclit level exceeded the normal range.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: age = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)); patient with two or more laboratory examinations refers to COUNT(ID) > 2; hematoclit level exceeded the normal range refers to HCT > = 52;

cases.title: How many of the patients with the most serious thrombosis cases examined in
cases.question:
How many of the patients with the most serious thrombosis cases examined in 1997 are women?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: the most serious thrombosis refers to Thrombosis = '1' (the most severe one); women refers to sex = 'F'

cases.title: Provide ID, sex and age of patient who has blood glucose (GLU) not within n
cases.question:
Provide ID, sex and age of patient who has blood glucose (GLU) not within normal range but with total cholesterol(T-CHO) within normal range.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: age = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)); blood glucose (GLU) not within normal range refers to GLU > = 180; total cholesterol(T-CHO) within normal range refers to `T-CHO` < 250;

cases.title: For patient born between 1936-1956, how many male patients have creatinine
cases.question:
For patient born between 1936-1956, how many male patients have creatinine phosphokinase beyond the normal range?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: born between 1936-1956 refers to year(Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'; male patients refers to sex = 'M'; creatinine phosphokinase beyond the normal range refers to CPK > = 250; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;

cases.title: What is the ratio of male to female patients among all those with abnormal
cases.question:
What is the ratio of male to female patients among all those with abnormal uric acid counts?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: male refers to SEX = 'M'; female refers to SEX = 'F'; abnormal uric acid refers to UA < = '8.0' where SEX = 'M', UA < = '6.5' where SEX = 'F'; calculation = DIVIDE(SUM(UA <= '8.0' and SEX = 'M'), SUM(UA <= '6.5 and SEX = 'F'))

cases.title: What number of patients with a degree of thrombosis level 2 and ANA pattern
cases.question:
What number of patients with a degree of thrombosis level 2 and ANA pattern of only S, have a level of anti-Cardiolip in antibody (IgM) 20% higher than average?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: thrombosis level 2 refers to Thrombosis = 2; ANA pattern of only S refers to ANA = 'S'; average anti-Cardiolip in antibody (IgM) refers to AVG(`aCL IgM`); calculation = MULTIPLY(AVG + AVG, 0.2)

cases.title: List and group all patients by sex for total bilirubin (T-BIL) level not wi
cases.question:
List and group all patients by sex for total bilirubin (T-BIL) level not within the normal range.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: List refers to GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ID); total bilirubin (T-BIL) not within normal range refers to T-BIL > = 2.0

cases.title: How many patients with a abnormal C-reactive protein don't have their data
cases.question:
How many patients with a abnormal C-reactive protein don't have their data recorded?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: abnormal C-reactive protein refers to CRP ='+'; don't have data recorded refers to Description IS NULL;

cases.title: How many patients who were examined between 1987/7/6 and 1996/1/31 had a GP
cases.question:
How many patients who were examined between 1987/7/6 and 1996/1/31 had a GPT level greater than 30 and an ALB level less than 4? List them by their ID.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: examined between 1987/7/6 and 1996/1/31 refers to Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'; GPT level greater than 30 refers to GPT > 30; ALB level less than 4 ALB < 4

cases.title: For laboratory examinations take in 1984, list all patients below 50 years
cases.question:
For laboratory examinations take in 1984, list all patients below 50 years old with normal platelet level.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: laboratory examinations take in 1984 refers to YEAR(Date) = '1984'; below 50 years old = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)) < 50; normal platelet level refers to PLT between 100 and 400;

cases.title: For all patients who are older than 55 years old, what is the percentage of
cases.question:
For all patients who are older than 55 years old, what is the percentage of female who has abnormal prothrombin time (PT)?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: older than 55 years old = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)) > 55; abnormal prothrombin time (PT) refers to PT > = 14; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(PT > = 14 AND SEX = 'F'), SUM(PT > = 14)) * 100; female refers to sex = 'F';

cases.title: Among the patients who has a normal anti-scl70, how many of them are female
cases.question:
Among the patients who has a normal anti-scl70, how many of them are female and does not have any symptom?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: normal anti-scl70 refers to SC170 IN('negative', '0'); female refers to Sex = 'F'; does not have any symptom refers to symptoms IS NULL; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;

cases.title:
What is the average age of the male patient with high cholesterol?
Benchmar
cases.question:
What is the average age of the male patient with high cholesterol?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: average age = DIVIDE(SUM(SUBTRACT(YEAR(NOW()), YEAR(birthday))), COUNT(ID)); male patient refers to sex = 'M'; high cholesterol refers to `T-CHO` > = 250;

cases.title: For the patient who was diagnosed with SLE on 1994/2/19, what was his/her a
cases.question:
For the patient who was diagnosed with SLE on 1994/2/19, what was his/her anti-Cardiolipin antibody concentration status on 1993/11/12?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: diagnosed with SLE refers to Diagnosis = 'SLE'; 1994/2/19 refers to Description = '1994-02-19'; anti-Cardiolipin refers to aCL IgM; 1993/11/12 refers to Examination Date = '1993/11/12'

cases.title:
State the ID and age of patient with positive degree of coagulation.
Benchm
cases.question:
State the ID and age of patient with positive degree of coagulation.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: age refers to SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)); positive degree of coagulation refers to RVVT = '+';

cases.title: Among the patients who have an abnormal level of glutamic oxaloacetic trans
cases.question:
Among the patients who have an abnormal level of glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase, when was the youngest of them born?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: abnormal level of glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase refers to GOT > = 60; The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa;

cases.title: For patients with abnormal platelet level, state the number of patients wit
cases.question:
For patients with abnormal platelet level, state the number of patients with lower than normal range. How is it compare to the number of patients with higher than normal range?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: abnormal platelet level refers to PLT <= 100 or PLT >= 400; platelet level lower than normal range refers to PLT < 100; calculation = SUBTRACT(SUM(PLT < 100), SUM(PLT > 400)); platelet level higher than normal range refers to PLT > 400;

cases.title: Please provide the diagnosis of patients with ALT glutamic pylvic transamin
cases.question:
Please provide the diagnosis of patients with ALT glutamic pylvic transaminase beyond the normal range by ascending order of their date of birth.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: ALT glutamic pylvic transaminase beyond the normal range refers to GPT > 60; The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa;

cases.title: How many patients with a normal Ig A level came to the hospital after 1990/
cases.question:
How many patients with a normal Ig A level came to the hospital after 1990/1/1?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: normal Ig A level refers to IGA > 80 AND IGA < 500; came to the hospital after 1990/1/1 refers to YEAR(`First Date`) > = 1990;

cases.title: List the patient ID, sex and birthday of patient with LDH beyond normal ran
cases.question:
List the patient ID, sex and birthday of patient with LDH beyond normal range.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: LDH beyond normal range refers to LDH > '500';

cases.title:
Was the patient with the number 57266's uric acid within a normal range?
Be
cases.question:
Was the patient with the number 57266's uric acid within a normal range?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: uric acid within a normal range refers to UA > 8.0 and SEX = 'M'OR UA > 6.5 and SEX = 'F'

cases.title:
How many female patients were given an APS diagnosis?
Benchmark knowledge e
cases.question:
How many female patients were given an APS diagnosis?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: female refers to SEX = 'F'; APS diagnosis refers to Diagnosis='APS'
